era: 约 788 年生于印度喀拉拉马拉巴尔海岸的迦底村（婆罗门家庭，幼年丧父）——少年师从乔荼波陀一系的导师牧尊（Govinda），在纳尔马达河畔出家为游方僧——确立'不二论吠檀多'（Advaita Vedanta）纲领：梵（Brahman）是唯一实在，'我'（Atman）即梵，现象世界的多性是无明（ avidya）所生的幻现——约 788-820 年间徒步遍行次大陆：从喜马拉雅的巴德林纳特到南印度的斯林格里，以'立敌对论'的公开辩论（śāstrārtha）降服弥曼差、佛教与耆那教学者，传说中与曼陀罗弥湿罗的论辩使贝纳雷斯改宗吠檀多——为传法建立四座根本道场（阿默尔沃蒂、德瓦拉卡、普里、乔提尔/斯林格里，一说还有迦西），立'十名'僧团传承——完成'三经疏'（对《梵经》《薄伽梵歌》、主要《奥义书》的注疏，即 prasthāna-traya）以及《千部解脱论》（Upadeśasāhasrī）、《分辨宝鬘》（Vivekacūḍāmaṇi）等独立著作——约 32 岁在喜马拉雅迦西（一说凯达纳特）去世，传说以'入定离去'收束一生。他生前被部分正统派视为'假佛教徒'（pracchanna-bauddha），身后却成为印度教复兴最重要的哲学奠基人，被尊为'商羯罗阿阇梨'（Shankaracharya）
era_en: Born c. 788 in Kaladi on the Malabar coast of Kerala, into a Brahmin family, fatherless in early childhood—as a boy he took renunciation under Govinda of the lineage of Gaudapada on the banks of the Narmada, becoming a wandering monk—and gave Advaita Vedanta its program: Brahman alone is real, the Self (Atman) is Brahman, the manifold world is appearance born of ignorance (avidya)—between c. 788 and 820 he walked the length of the subcontinent, from Badrinath in the Himalaya to Sringeri in the south, defeating Mimamsa, Buddhist and Jaina scholars in open disputation (sastratha)—legendarily converting Banaras to Vedanta in the debate with Mandana Misra—and founded four paramount monasteries (Sringeri, Dwarka, Puri, Joshi/Badrinath) with the Dashanami order of renouncers—and wrote the 'commentaries on the three foundations' (prasthanatraya: the Brahma-sutras, the Bhagavad Gita, the principal Upanishads) together with independent works, the Upadesasahasri ('A Thousand Teachings'), the Vivekacudamani ('Crest-Jewel of Discrimination')—dying at about thirty-two at Kashi (or Kedarnath) in the Himalaya, said to have departed in meditation. Some orthodox critics in his lifetime called him a 'crypto-Buddhist'; after his death he became the most important philosophical founder of the Hindu revival, honored as 'Shankaracharya'
school: 不二论吠檀多的立法者（梵我不二，'唯一实在'的形上学总纲）/ 遮诠辩证法的大师（以'不是、不是'（neti neti）界定绝对）/ 立敌对论的辩论工程师（先把对手观点立到最强再驳）/ 注疏传统的重塑者（以注'三经'的方式为新学派立法）/ 亲证优先的修行方法论者（经典指向、体验裁决）
historical_significance: 商羯罗（约788-820），印度哲学家、吠檀多不二论的集大成者，被广泛视为印度教哲学传统的最大塑造者之一。他的历史地位由五件事锚定。其一，'不二论'总纲的确立：梵是唯一不落的实在，'我'（阿特曼）即梵——他把《奥义书》'梵我同一'的散见命题锻造成一座完整的形上学体系，并以'幻'（maya）与'无明'解释多样世界的现起，'不二而不一，幻现而非无'。其二，'三经疏'的立法工程：他选择为《梵经》、十部主要《奥义书》与《薄伽梵歌》作注——借注疏的外衣行立法之实，从此吠檀多取代弥曼差成为婆罗门教义学的中心舞台，其后所有吠檀多学派（罗摩奴阇的限定不二论、摩陀伐的二元论）都必须先回应商羯罗。其三，辩论方法论：'立敌对论'（purvapaksha 先立敌论）——把对手立场表述到比对手自己更强，再加以驳斥——这套论辩工艺使他的论著至今是印度哲学论辩范式的教科书。其四，制度性遗产：四大根本道场与'十名'游方僧团，把哲学变成可持续八百年的组织系统；至今四位商羯罗阿阇梨仍被视为印度教的最高教阶之一。其五，修行方法论：'四备'（分辨、离欲、六德、求解脱）与'亲证'（anubhava）优先——经典只是地图，解脱必须由直接的自我认知达成。代价与极限：为保'吠陀权威'他不得不承认吠陀仪式在日常层面的有效性，使体系带上'两谛'的分层妥协；对幻的界定引出'个体如何无明、梵为何生幻'的诘难（后世'无明归属难题'）；三十二岁早逝使体系多有赖后世弟子（如筏遮塞波底）补全。他至今仍是'印度哲学'在国际语境中的默认面孔。
historical_significance_en: Adi Shankara (c. 788-820), Indian philosopher and the great systematizer of Advaita Vedanta, is widely regarded as one of the most influential shapers of Hindu philosophical tradition. Five achievements anchor his standing. First, the program of non-dualism: Brahman alone is the unfailing reality and the Self (Atman) is Brahman—he forged the scattered Upanishadic sayings of 'Brahman-Atman identity' into a complete metaphysical system, explaining the manifold world through maya (appearance) and ignorance (avidya): 'non-dual yet not one, apparent yet not nothing.' Second, the legislative project of the prasthanatraya: he chose to comment on the Brahma-sutras, the ten principal Upanishads and the Bhagavad Gita—legislation in the dress of commentary—so that Vedanta displaced Mimamsa at the center of Brahminical doctrine, and every later Vedanta school (Ramanuja's qualified non-dualism, Madhva's dualism) had to answer Shankara first. Third, dialectical method: purvapaksha—the opponent's view first stated in its strongest form, then refuted—a craft that keeps his treatises the textbook of Indian philosophical disputation. Fourth, the institutional legacy: four paramount monasteries and the Dashanami order, turning philosophy into an organization eight centuries durable; the four Shankaracharyas remain among the highest dignities of Hinduism. Fifth, soteriological method: the fourfold qualifications (discrimination, dispassion, the six virtues, the desire for liberation) with the priority of direct experience (anubhava)—scripture is only a map; liberation must be achieved by direct self-knowledge. Costs and limits: to preserve Vedic authority he had to concede the validity of ritual at the everyday level, stratifying his system into 'two truths'; his account of maya invites the classic objection—whose is the ignorance, and why does Brahman generate appearance (the problem of the locus of avidya); his death at thirty-two left the system to be completed by successors such as Vacaspati Misra. He remains the default face of 'Indian philosophy' in the international context.
unique_thinking: 他思维方式的底色是'分辨为刃、遮诠为路：绝对不可定义，只能通过系统否定逼近；一切对立都是无明的投影'。六个标志性动作。其一，'不二还原法'——对任何经验对象连续追问'它是独立的实在吗'，把现象一层层还原到唯一不落的基础（梵），还原的终点不是'一个最大的东西'而是'一切分别的消融'。其二，'遮诠显真法'——对绝对只作否定性定义（'不是这，不是那'），凡可指认、可言说的都被否定，留下的沉默即是答案——避免把绝对降格为概念。其三，'幻相层级法'——把'实在'分为三级（错觉层/日常层/究竟层），同一物在不同层级有不同真值，冲突由'层级错位'消解，而非由一方压倒另一方。其四，'立敌对论法'——辩论前先把对手立场重构为最强形态（purvapaksha），再从其内部引出自毁——驳倒的必须是'最强的对手'，否则胜利无效。其五，'亲证检验法'——经典与推理都只是'指向的手指'，最终裁决在直接体验（anubhava）：'梵我同一'必须被亲证，而非被相信。其六，'目证自明法'——意识是自明自证的'见证'（sakshi）：一切认识需要认识者，而认识者本身不需要被认识，如同灯不自需照。代价与极限：遮诠方法的极致使积极主张稀缺，体系在'说了什么'上显得沉默；幻相层级在实践上易滑向'轻视世界'（他本人因此被质疑反伦理、反行动）；为吠陀权威保留的仪式层与非二元核心之间的张力从未彻底解决。
unique_thinking_en: The bedrock of his thinking: discrimination as the blade, apophasis as the road—the absolute cannot be defined, only approached through systematic negation, and every opposition is a projection of ignorance. Six signature moves. First, non-dual reduction—of any experienced object, ask in succession 'is it an independent reality,' dissolving phenomena layer by layer into the one unfailing ground (Brahman); the terminus is not 'the largest thing' but the dissolution of all distinction. Second, apophatic definition—the absolute receives only negative predication ('not this, not that'); whatever can be pointed at or spoken is denied, and the silence left standing is the answer—keeping the absolute from degradation into a concept. Third, the hierarchy of reality—'real' comes in three grades (illusion, the everyday, the ultimate); the same object holds different truth-values at different levels, and conflict is dissolved as level-mismatch rather than settled by one side crushing the other. Fourth, the strongest-opponent method—before debate, reconstruct the adversary's position into its strongest form (purvapaksha), then draw self-destruction from within it; only the strongest opponent is worth refuting, else the victory is void. Fifth, experience-verification—scripture and inference are both 'fingers pointing'; final judgment lies in direct experience (anubhava): 'Brahman is the Self' must be realized, not believed. Sixth, witness-awareness—consciousness is the self-luminous witness (sakshi): every cognition requires a cognizer, and the cognizer itself needs no cognizing, as a lamp needs no lighting. Costs and limits: apophasis at its extreme leaves positive doctrine scarce, the system famously silent on 'what it affirms'; the hierarchy of reality in practice slides toward contempt for the world (he was charged with anti-ethics, anti-action); the tension between the ritual layer kept for Vedic authority and the non-dual core was never fully resolved.
civilization_zh: 南亚印度文明（八至九世纪，喀拉拉马拉巴尔海岸的婆罗门社会、纳尔马达河与喜马拉雅的游方僧传统、贝纳雷斯与南印度的经院论辩网络），兼容奥义书一元论传统（'梵我同一'、'汝即彼'）与佛教中观/唯识的论辩技术
civilization_en: The civilization of South Asia (eighth to ninth centuries): the Brahmin society of the Malabar coast of Kerala, the renouncer traditions of the Narmada and the Himalaya, the scholastic disputation networks of Banaras and the south—in dialogue with the Upanishadic monist heritage ('Brahman-Atman identity,' 'thou art that') and the dialectical techniques of Buddhist Madhyamaka and Yogacara

'三经疏'的注疏立法者（借注疏行立法，使吠檀多取代弥曼差成为义学中心）
次大陆论辩的'降服者'（立敌对论方法的工程化示范）

roles_en: The great systematizer of Advaita Vedanta (legislator of the 'Brahman-Atman non-dual' metaphysics)
Commentarial legislator of the prasthanatraya (legislation through commentary, displacing Mimamsa at the doctrinal center)
The 'subduer' of the subcontinent's disputations (the engineered demonstration of purvapaksha method)
Founder of the four paramount monasteries and the Dashanami order (the institutionalization of philosophy)
The most important philosophical founder of the Hindu revival (honored as 'Shankaracharya')
key_works: 《梵经注》（Brahmasūtrabhāṣya——不二论形上学的总纲与论辩主战场）
《千部解脱论》（Upadeśasāhasrī——唯一可靠归于他本人的独立论著，亲证方法论的完整陈述）

《五百行论》（或归于其门下——不二论在行动与伦理问题上的立场陈述）

幻 maya（多样世界的幻现与无明 avidya 的机制）
遮诠 apophasis（'不是这，不是那' neti neti 的否定性定义法）

亲证 anubhava（直接体验作为认识与解脱的最终裁决）

name_zh: 形上学追问方法论/对任何经验对象连续追问'它是独立的实在吗'，把现象一层层还原到唯一不落的基础（梵）——还原的终点不是'一个最大的东西'，而是一切分别的消融：能所双泯，主客同销
name_en: metaphysical-inquiry methodology/ask of any experienced object in succession 'is it an independent reality,' dissolving phenomena layer by layer into the one unfailing ground (Brahman)—the terminus is not 'the largest thing' but the dissolution of all distinction: subject and object extinguished together
category: 形上学追问方法论/对任何经验对象连续追问'它是独立的实在吗'，把现象一层层还原到唯一不落的基础（梵）——还原的终点不是'一个最大的东西'，而是一切分别的消融：能所双泯，主客同销
modes.domain_zh: 《梵经注》开头即是这套方法的完整示范。商羯罗对'多样世界'连续发问：身体是独立的实在吗？——不，它依食物与元素；感官呢？——依身体；心识呢？——依感官与对象；连'空'也被追问——空的观念仍是一个观念，依意识而立。还原一层层剥掉'独立性'，最后只剩'意识本身'无法被还原：因为一切还原都以'被意识到'为前提，而意识不能怀疑自身。于是结论不是'宇宙中有个最大的存在者'，而是'分别本身不究竟'——多样是在唯一基础上的表相。这与西方'第一因'论证的分岔就在此处：亚里士多德的终点是'不动的推动者'（一个最高存在者，与其他存在者同类而更高），商羯罗的终点是'消融'（那个基础不是诸存在中的一个，而是'存在'本身）。《分辨宝鬘》把它教成阶梯：从'我不是身体'到'我不是感官'到'我不是心'到'我是见证'——每一步都是一次还原。代价与极限：还原的终点无法被命题式地陈述（说出'梵'就已经把它对象化），所以此法必须与遮诠（M-SHA-005）配套使用；且还原若停留在理智层面而不进入亲证，就只是又一次概念游戏。
modes.domain_en: The commentary on the Brahma-sutras opens with the complete demonstration. Shankara interrogates the manifold world in succession: is the body an independent reality?—no, it depends on food and elements; the senses?—on the body; the mind?—on the senses and their objects; even 'space' is questioned—the idea of space is still an idea, standing on consciousness. Reduction strips 'independence' layer after layer, until only consciousness itself cannot be reduced: every reduction presupposes 'being conscious of,' and consciousness cannot doubt itself. The conclusion is not 'there is a greatest being in the universe' but 'distinction itself is not ultimate'—the manifold is appearance on one ground. The fork from the Western 'first cause' lies here: Aristotle's terminus is the unmoved mover (a highest being, of the same kind as the others but higher), Shankara's terminus is dissolution (the ground is not one being among beings but Being itself). The Vivekacudamani teaches it as a ladder: from 'I am not the body' to 'not the senses' to 'not the mind' to 'I am the witness'—each step one reduction. Costs and limits: the terminus cannot be stated propositionally (to say 'Brahman' is already to objectify it), so the method must be paired with apophasis (M-SHA-005); and reduction that stays intellectual without entering realization is only another concept game.

modes.definition_en: Metaphysical-inquiry methodology/ask of any experienced object in succession 'is it an independent reality,' dissolving phenomena layer by layer into the one unfailing ground—the terminus is not 'the largest thing' but the dissolution of all distinction
modes.source_chapter: 《梵经注》（Brahmasūtrabhāṣya）1.1 论梵之本性；《分辨宝鬘》'我不是身体'阶梯；《千部解脱论》第十八篇论意识不可还原
key_concepts: 独立性追问 the question of independence
层层还原 reduction layer by layer
意识不可还原 consciousness irreducible
消融而非最高者 dissolution, not a highest being
理智还原与亲证还原 intellectual vs realized reduction
modes.key_quote_zh: 凡是可见者皆非观者；一切还原止于那不能被还原的觉知。
modes.key_quote_en: Whatever is seen is not the seer; all reduction ends at the awareness that cannot be reduced.
process_zh: 对对象提出还原问句：'它依什么而立？'——每答出一层依存，就把该层降格为'派生的'
沿依存链继续下问，直到抵达一个'它依他而立'的回答不再成立的项——那项即候补的基础
检验候补基础：它是否也是'被经验的对象'？若是，还原继续——直到只剩'经验本身/意识本身'
区分'最高者'与'消融'：若结论仍是诸存在中的一个存在者，说明还原未完成——真正的终点是分别本身的消融
process_en: Put the reduction question to the object: 'on what does it stand?'—each answer names a dependence, demoting that layer to the derivative
Continue down the chain of dependence until reaching a term for which no answer of the form 'it stands on something else' holds—that term is the candidate ground
Test the candidate: is it also 'an experienced object'? If so, continue—until only experience itself, consciousness itself, remains
Distinguish 'highest being' from 'dissolution': if the conclusion is still one being among beings, the reduction is incomplete—the true terminus is the dissolution of distinction itself
representative_cases_zh: 《梵经注》：对身体→感官→心识→空的连续还原，止于不可还原的意识——'多样是唯一基础上的表相'的总纲示范
《分辨宝鬘》：'我不是身体/感官/心'的阶梯教学——把还原法教成可操作的日常修行程序
与'第一因'论证的分岔：亚里士多德止于'不动的推动者'（最高存在者），商羯罗坚持还原到'存在本身'——同一方法、两种终点的对照
representative_cases_en: The Brahma-sutra commentary: the chain body-senses-mind-space reduced to irreducible consciousness—the founding demonstration that the manifold is appearance on one ground
The Vivekacudamani: the ladder 'I am not the body/senses/mind'—the method taught as a workable daily procedure
The fork from the first-cause argument: Aristotle stops at the unmoved mover (a highest being), Shankara insists on reduction to Being itself—same method, two termini
modern_applications_zh: 根本原因分析：对问题连续追问'它依什么而立'，不满足于找到'最大的原因'，而是找到'一切原因共同预设的那一项'（常是未言明的框架）
产品定位：连续追问'这个卖点依什么成立'，把功能层层还原到用户无法再还原的那个'体验本身'——差异化不在功能堆叠而在基础层
哲学/科学史阅读训练：读任何体系先问'它的还原止于何处、为何止于此'——终点选择往往决定整个体系的形状
modern_applications_en: Root-cause analysis: keep asking 'on what does this stand?'—do not settle for the largest cause; find the item all causes jointly presuppose (often an unstated framework)

Product positioning: ask in succession 'on what does this selling point stand,' reducing features to the 'experience itself' the user cannot reduce further—differentiation lives at the ground layer, not the feature stack
Training in reading philosophy and history of science: of any system first ask 'where does its reduction stop, and why'—the choice of terminus usually decides the shape of the whole system

representative_figures.relation_zh: 本模式的原型——把'连续还原到不落之基'立法为不二论的第一方法
representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—who legislated continuous reduction to the unfailing ground as the first method of non-dualism

representative_figures.relation_zh: 方法的先师——《曼陀卡耶疏》以'不生'（ajati）论证先于商羯罗演示了还原的激进形态
representative_figures.relation_en: the precursor of the method—the Mandukya-karika's doctrine of 'non-origination' (ajati) demonstrated the radical form of reduction before Shankara

representative_figures.relation_zh: 平行对照——从普遍怀疑还原到意识自明的'我疑故我在'，与商羯罗的意识不可还原同构而异趣
representative_figures.relation_en: the parallel—reduction from universal doubt to the self-evidence of consciousness ('I doubt, therefore I am') isomorphic with Shankara's irreducible consciousness

name_zh: 终极命题方法论/'汝即彼'（tat tvam asi）——把宇宙论的最高项（梵）与自我认知的最深处（我/阿特曼）判定为同一：不是'我属于梵'或'我类似梵'，而是'我即梵'——一切救赎论与认识论的杠杆都从这一等式的成立与否中取得
name_en: ultimate-proposition methodology/'thou art that' (tat tvam asi)—the judgment that the highest term of cosmology (Brahman) and the deepest stratum of self-knowledge (the Self, Atman) are identical: not 'I belong to Brahman' or 'I resemble Brahman' but 'I am Brahman'—every lever of soteriology and epistemology hangs on whether this equation holds
category: 终极命题方法论/'汝即彼'（tat tvam asi）——把宇宙论的最高项（梵）与自我认知的最深处（我/阿特曼）判定为同一：不是'我属于梵'或'我类似梵'，而是'我即梵'
modes.domain_zh: 商羯罗在《梵经注》1.1.4 与《千部解脱论》中反复论证：奥义书说'汝即彼'，若'汝'（个体我）与'彼'（宇宙梵）只是相似或隶属，这句圣传句（mahavakya）就什么也没说——所以必须是同一（samarasa）。论证策略有二。其一是语义分层：'汝'这个词有两义——表层义（有身之我，wrinkled face、种姓、记忆）与深层义（纯觉之我），'彼'亦然——表层不能等同（有身之我不是全宇宙），深层才能等同（纯觉无分别）。'汝即彼'在表层为假，在深层为真——这是他著名的 lakshana（间接指示义）解释法。其二是体验裁决：无梦深眠中被引为'我睡得很香、我觉知到无'的那个'觉知'，既非身体也非个我的心识，而是不落的纯觉——日常经验里已有'我即梵'的样品。方法的战略意义：一旦等式成立，'解脱'从'抵达某处'改写为'认出本来'——不是获得什么，而是取消一个误认。代价与极限：语义分层被对手批评为'巧辩'（你把两个词都改义后宣布它们相等）；等式的体验基础（深眠论证）在现象学上可争议；且'我即梵'在社会层面易被误用为'我无所不是'的傲慢——商羯罗以'两谛'（M-SHA-003）限制其适用层。
modes.domain_en: In the Brahma-sutra commentary 1.1.4 and the Upadesasahasri Shankara argues repeatedly: the Upanishad says 'thou art that'; if 'thou' (the individual self) and 'that' (cosmic Brahman) were merely similar or subordinate, the great saying (mahavakya) would say nothing—so the identity (samarasa) must be literal. Two argumentative strategies. First, semantic stratification: 'thou' has two senses—the surface self (the embodied person, caste, memory) and the deep self (pure awareness), and so does 'that'—surface cannot be equated (the embodied self is not the universe), depth can (pure awareness has no distinction). 'Thou art that' is false at the surface, true at the depth—his celebrated lakshana (indicated meaning) interpretation. Second, the arbitration of experience: the awareness invoked in dreamless sleep—'I slept well, I knew the nothing'—is neither body nor individual mind but unfailing pure awareness; daily experience already contains a specimen of 'I am Brahman.' The strategic meaning: once the equation holds, 'liberation' is rewritten from 'reaching somewhere' to 'recognizing what already is'—not gaining something but cancelling a misidentification. Costs and limits: semantic stratification was attacked as special pleading (redefine both words and declare them equal); the experiential basis (the deep-sleep argument) is phenomenologically contestable; and 'I am Brahman' in the social register risks the arrogance of 'I am everything'—Shankara confines it to its level through the two truths (M-SHA-003).
modes.definition_zh: 终极命题方法论/'汝即彼'——把宇宙论的最高项（梵）与自我认知的最深处（阿特曼）判定为同一：不是隶属或相似，而是'我即梵'——一切救赎论与认识论的杠杆系于此等式
modes.definition_en: Ultimate-proposition methodology/'thou art that'—the judgment that the highest term of cosmology (Brahman) and the deepest stratum of self-knowledge (Atman) are identical: not subordination or resemblance but literal identity—every lever of soteriology and epistemology hangs on this equation
modes.source_chapter: 《梵经注》1.1.4 论圣传句之义；《千部解脱论》第一、十八篇；《唱赞奥义书》6.8-16 '汝即彼'原本语境
key_concepts: 圣传句 mahavakya（'汝即彼'的立法性命题）
语义分层 semantic stratification（表层义与指示义 lakshana）
深眠论证 the deep-sleep argument
同一 samarasa（字面的而非隐喻的等同）
解脱即认出 liberation as recognition
modes.key_quote_zh: 汝即彼——不是相似，不是隶属，是同一。
modes.key_quote_en: Thou art that—not resemblance, not subordination, but identity.
process_zh: 找出待考察的最高命题（如'汝即彼'），先写下它的字面义并设问：若作弱化解读（相似/隶属），命题还有没有信息量？
为命题两端各做语义分层：表层义（可描述、可指认的）与深层义（不可描述、只可指示的）
检验等式只在深层成立：表层等式有反例即弃，深层等式须有经验样品（如深眠中的纯觉）佐证
推演等式的后果：一旦同一成立，原目标（解脱/解决）从'获得/抵达'改写为'取消误认'——所有下游策略随之改变
process_en: Identify the highest proposition under review ('thou art that'); write down its literal sense and ask: under weakened readings (resemblance/subordination), does the proposition still carry information?
Stratify the semantics of both terms: a surface sense (describable, pointable-at) and a deep sense (indescribable, only indicated)
Test the equation at the depth alone: discard it if surface counterexamples exist; support the deep equation with an experiential specimen (such as the pure awareness of deep sleep)

Derive the consequences: once identity holds, the original goal (liberation/the solution) is rewritten from 'acquisition/arrival' to 'cancelling a misidentification'—all downstream strategy changes with it
representative_cases_zh: 《梵经注》1.1.4：为使'汝即彼'有信息量，以 lakshana 间接指示义分层两词——语义分层法的经典立法
《千部解脱论》：以深眠中的'觉知到无'为'我即梵'的日常样品——体验裁决的示范
解脱观的改写：从不二论看，'解脱'不是死后抵达梵界（那是表层最高），而是当下取消'我是有身之我'的误认——同一命题重写全部救赎策略
representative_cases_en: Brahma-sutra commentary 1.1.4: to make 'thou art that' informative, both terms are stratified by lakshana, the indicated meaning—the founding legislation of semantic stratification
The Upadesasahasri: the 'awareness of nothing' in deep sleep as the daily specimen of 'I am Brahman'—the demonstration of experience-arbitration

The rewrite of liberation: on non-dualism, liberation is not arriving at the world of Brahman after death (the surface maximum) but cancelling here and now the misidentification 'I am this embodied self'—one proposition rewriting the whole soteriological strategy
modern_applications_zh: 谈判/整合中的'等式检验'：当双方提出各自最高命题（'我们的方案就是答案'），先做语义分层——表层冲突是否掩盖深层同一（共同的真实利益）
战略定位：把组织的最高使命与成员的最深动机做同一性检验——'你做的事就是你这个人'的等式成立时，招聘与留存策略全部改写
概念辨析训练：遇到'X即Y'式最高命题（'数据即资产''用户即上帝'），先问'作弱化解读还有无信息量'，再做两端分层检验
modern_applications_en: The equation test in negotiation and integration: when each side offers its highest proposition ('our plan is the answer'), stratify the semantics first—does surface conflict mask deep identity (the shared real interest)?

Strategic positioning: test the identity between an organization's highest mission and its members' deepest motivation—when 'what you do is who you are' holds, recruiting and retention strategy rewrite entirely
Training in conceptual analysis: on 'X is Y' ultimate propositions ('data is the asset,' 'the user is god'), first ask whether the weakened reading still carries information, then stratify both terms

representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—who forged 'thou art that' from a scriptural saying into the master lever of dialectic and soteriology

representative_figures.relation_en: the precursor—whose analysis of waking, dream and deep sleep supplied the phenomenological material for the identity thesis

name_zh: 真理分级方法论/把'实在'分为三级——错觉层（pratibhasika，绳误作蛇）、日常层（vyavaharika，日常有效）、究竟层（paramarthika，唯梵不落）——同一物在不同层级有不同真值，一切表面冲突都先检查'层级错位'再裁决，而非由一方压倒另一方
name_en: graded-truth methodology/'real' comes in three grades—illusory (pratibhasika, rope mistaken for snake), everyday (vyavaharika, valid in daily life), ultimate (paramarthika, Brahman alone unfailing)—the same object holds different truth-values at different levels; every surface conflict is first checked for level-mismatch before adjudication, never settled by one side crushing the other
category: 真理分级方法论/把'实在'分为三级——错觉层、日常层、究竟层——同一物在不同层级有不同真值，一切表面冲突先检查'层级错位'再裁决
modes.domain_zh: 这是商羯罗体系中最具现代共鸣的方法装置。经典例子：黄昏见绳为蛇——蛇在错觉层完全'真实'（心跳、逃跑皆真），在日光（证知）后蛇'从未存在'，而绳在两个层都'在'。他把世界的多样性定位在日常层：在日常层，因果、道德、种姓、吠陀仪式全部有效（他不否认任何一条）；但在究竟层，这一切都是'无明所现的蛇'。关键操作是'层级纪律'：究竟层的真理（梵我不二）不得用来取消日常层的义务（他不赞成'既然一切是幻就无须行动'）；日常层的经验（因果有效）也不得越级否证究竟层（'我看见多样'不能证伪'梵是唯一'——因为'看见'本身在日常层成立）。这一纪律使他不二论免于两种流行谬误：虚无主义（一切皆幻故什么都可以）与独断主义（我的层级压倒你的层级）。《薄伽梵歌注》把'两谛'教为行为准则：知究竟者仍按俗谛履行职分。代价与极限：层级划分本身就是体系性的'分身'——批评者（罗摩奴阇）指其'两谛'使梵在某种意义上仍受幻污染；且层级判定权在谁手里，是此法永远的政治问题。
modes.domain_en: The most modernly resonant device in Shankara's system. The classic example: at dusk a rope is mistaken for a snake—the snake is fully 'real' at the illusory level (heartbeat, flight are real); after the lamp (knowledge) the snake 'never existed,' while the rope is present at both levels. He locates the world's manifoldness at the everyday level: there, causation, morality, caste and Vedic ritual are all valid (he denies none of them); at the ultimate level all of it is 'the snake of ignorance.' The key operation is level-discipline: the truth of the ultimate level (Brahman-Atman non-duality) must not be used to cancel the obligations of the everyday (he rejects 'since all is illusion, no action is needed'); and everyday experience (causation works) must not overstep to refute the ultimate ('I see multiplicity' cannot falsify 'Brahman alone'—for 'seeing' itself holds only at the everyday level). This discipline saves non-dualism from two popular fallacies: nihilism ('all is illusion, so anything goes') and dogmatism ('my level crushes your level'). The Gita commentary teaches the two truths as conduct: the knower of the ultimate still performs his duty within the conventional. Costs and limits: the hierarchy itself is a systemic 'split'—critics such as Ramanuja charged that on the two-truths scheme Brahman remains tainted by maya in some sense; and who holds the power to assign levels is the perpetual politics of this method.
modes.definition_zh: 真理分级方法论/把'实在'分为错觉层、日常层、究竟层三级——同一物在不同层级有不同真值，一切表面冲突先检查'层级错位'再裁决，不由一方压倒另一方
modes.definition_en: Graded-truth methodology/'real' in three grades—illusory, everyday, ultimate—the same object holds different truth-values at different levels; every surface conflict is first checked for level-mismatch before adjudication
modes.source_chapter: 《梵经注》2.1 论幻与两谛；《薄伽梵歌注》论'知究竟者仍履行职分'；绳蛇喻见《分辨宝鬘》及诸注
key_concepts: 三级实在 three grades of reality
绳蛇喻 the rope-snake example
层级纪律 level-discipline
不越级否证 no cross-level refutation
知而不废行 knowing without abandoning action
modes.key_quote_zh: 蛇从未存在，绳从未消失——错在层级，不在对象。
modes.key_quote_en: The snake never existed, the rope never vanished—the error is in the level, not the object.
process_zh: 遇到冲突命题时，先为每一方标注'它在本层级是否有效'——多数冲突是层级错位而非事实错误
建立层级清单：本问题的错觉层（误认）、日常层（共同有效规则）、究竟层（不落的基础）各是什么
执行层级纪律：高层真理不取消低层义务，低层经验不越级否证高层——跨界陈述一律标记为无效
按层级分别处理：错觉层做纠正（点灯），日常层做优化（守规则），究竟层做认出——三种操作不可混用
process_en: On conflicting propositions, first mark for each 'is it valid at its level'—most conflicts are level-mismatch, not factual error
Build the level inventory: what are the illusory layer (misidentification), the everyday layer (shared working rules), the ultimate layer (the unfailing ground) of this question
Enforce level-discipline: higher truth does not cancel lower obligation; lower experience does not overstep to refute the higher—mark all cross-level statements void
Handle by level: correction at the illusory (light the lamp), optimization at the everyday (keep the rules), recognition at the ultimate—never mixing the three operations
representative_cases_zh: 绳蛇喻：蛇在错觉层真实（逃跑合理）、在证知后从未存在、绳在两层皆在——三级实在的完整标本
《薄伽梵歌注》：商羯罗坚持'知究竟者仍须履行种姓职分'——层级纪律防止'一切皆幻故无须行动'的虚无主义出口
对'我看见多样'的抗辩：'看见'的效力只限日常层，故不能越级证伪'梵是唯一'——不越级否证的论辩示范
representative_cases_en: The rope-snake: the snake real at the illusory level (flight justified), never existent after knowledge, the rope present at both levels—the complete specimen of graded reality
The Gita commentary: Shankara insists the knower of the ultimate still performs his station's duty—level-discipline closing the nihilist exit 'all is illusion, no action needed'
The defense against 'I see multiplicity': 'seeing' is valid only at the everyday level, hence cannot overstep to falsify 'Brahman alone'—the dialectical demonstration of no cross-level refutation
modern_applications_zh: 工程/科学的模型分层：把'地图不是疆域'操作化——物理模型、工程近似、日常直觉各有真值域，冲突先查层级再裁决（牛顿力学在低速层不被相对论'证伪'而是被'定位'）
组织沟通：把'愿景层真理'与'运营层规则'分级管理——愿景不取消流程义务，季度数据不越级否证使命
心理辅导：把'想法'与'事实'与'元认知'分三级——错觉层的灾难化想法做纠正，不做真伪辩论
modern_applications_en: Model layering in engineering and science: operationalizing 'the map is not the territory'—physical models, engineering approximations and everyday intuitions each hold a truth-domain; on conflict, check the level before adjudicating (Newtonian mechanics at low speed is 'located' by relativity, not 'falsified')
Organizational communication: manage 'vision-level truth' and 'operations-level rules' as graded—vision does not cancel process obligations; quarterly data does not overstep to refute the mission
Psychotherapy: grade 'thoughts,' 'facts' and 'metacognition'—catastrophizing at the illusory level is corrected, not debated for truth

representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—who legislated graded reality and level-discipline as the peace terms of non-dualism

representative_figures.relation_zh: 方法的先师——'二谛'（世俗谛/胜义谛）之分是层级法的佛教原型，商羯罗将其细化为三级

representative_figures.relation_zh: 平行对照——以现象/物自体分层消解理性矛盾，与绳蛇喻共享'错在层级不在对象'的结构

name_zh: 论辩方法论/辩论前先把对手立场重构为最强形态（purvapaksha，先立敌论）——以对手可能给出的最佳论证、最佳证据、最佳辩解来陈述其立场，再从其内部引出自毁；驳倒的必须是'最强的对手'，否则胜利无效
name_en: dialectical methodology/before debate, reconstruct the adversary's position into its strongest form (purvapaksha, 'the prior view')—stating it with the best arguments, best evidence and best defenses the opponent could give, then drawing self-destruction from within it; only the strongest opponent is worth refuting, else the victory is void
category: 论辩方法论/辩论前先把对手立场重构为最强形态（purvapaksha）——以对手可能给出的最佳论证陈述其立场，再从其内部引出自毁；驳倒的必须是'最强的对手'
modes.domain_zh: 商羯罗的注疏从不直接立论：每一部都先以整章篇幅替对手（弥曼差、数论、佛教唯识/经量部）把话说完——把对手的形上学前提、论证结构、对反驳的预期回应全部重构到最完备，然后才以 siddhanta（自宗义）应答。最著名的示范是《梵经注》对唯识的 purvapaksha：他先把'唯识无境'立得极强——一切认识皆识，境只是识的显现，此说能解释梦、错认、幻觉——再从内部追击：识若真无外境，识自身为何呈现为'有对象'的结构？记忆为何需要'曾被知觉'的锚点？谁记得识？——使唯识要么接受'识亦如境不可证'（自我瓦解），要么承认某种外在于'纯显现'的秩序。这套工艺的纪律性在于：purvapaksha 的强弱就是论著的信誉——对手派读者必须能承认'他理解的我们的立场比我们自己讲的还准确'，反驳才有效力。这一范式成为印度经院论辩的标准，并经由佛教因明学影响整个南亚与东亚的注疏传统。代价与极限：为最强对手写作使篇幅巨大、正面陈述反而稀薄；且若重构失真（立了个稻草人），整套胜利归于无效——此法对重构者的想象力与公正心要求极高。
modes.domain_en: Shankara's commentaries never argue directly: each spends whole chapters finishing the opponent's sentences—for Mimamsa, Samkhya and the Buddhist Yogacara/Sautrantika he reconstructs the metaphysical premises, argument structure and anticipated rebuttals to completeness, and only then answers with the siddhanta (his own doctrine). The most celebrated demonstration is the purvapaksha of Yogacara in the Brahma-sutra commentary: he states 'consciousness-only, no external object' at full strength—every cognition is consciousness, the object a display within it, the theory explaining dream, misperception, illusion—then strikes from within: if consciousness truly lacks an external object, why does it present itself with the structure of 'having an object'? Why does memory need the anchor of 'having once been perceived'? Who remembers the remembering?—forcing Yogacara either to accept that consciousness too is unprovable in just the way the object was (self-collapse) or to admit some order outside 'mere display.' The discipline of the craft: the strength of the purvapaksha is the treatise's credit—the opponent's readers must be able to grant 'he understood our position better than we stated it,' or the refutation carries no force. This became the standard of Indian scholastic disputation and, through Buddhist logic, shaped the commentary tradition of all South and East Asia. Costs and limits: writing for the strongest opponent makes treatises vast and the positive doctrine thin; and a distorted reconstruction (a straw man) voids the entire victory—the method demands extreme imagination and fairness from the reconstructor.
modes.definition_zh: 论辩方法论/辩论前先把对手立场重构为最强形态（purvapaksha）——以对手可能给出的最佳论证陈述其立场，再从其内部引出自毁；驳倒的必须是'最强的对手'，否则胜利无效
modes.definition_en: Dialectical methodology/before debate, reconstruct the adversary's position into its strongest form (purvapaksha)—stating it with the opponent's best arguments, then drawing self-destruction from within; only the strongest opponent is worth refuting
modes.source_chapter: 《梵经注》1.1 起对弥曼差与佛教诸派的 purvapaksha 章节设计；《千部解脱论》论论辩次第；印度经院论辩（śāstrārtha）传统规范

最强形态重构 strongest-form reconstruction
内部自毁 internal self-destruction
自宗义 siddhanta
重构信誉 the credit of reconstruction
modes.key_quote_zh: 未曾把敌论立到最强者，不配自称驳倒了它。
modes.key_quote_en: Whoever has not stated the opponent's view at its strongest may not claim to have refuted it.
process_zh: 写下对手立场的'最强版本'：前提、论证链、对已知反驳的预答——以'对手派读者会点头'为完成标准
在最强版本内部找张力：该立场为解释 A 现象付出的代价，是否恰好使它无法解释 B 现象
从内部构造二难：沿对手自己的前提推演，终点 either 自毁 either 须引入与其核心矛盾的新前提
应答（siddhanta）只做两件事：指认自毁点 + 陈述自己的立场如何吸收对手所解释的一切——不额外嘲讽
process_en: Write the strongest version of the opponent's position: premises, argument chain, anticipated answers to known objections—complete when the opponent's own readers would nod
Find the tension inside the strongest version: does the price the position pays to explain phenomenon A exactly disable it from explaining phenomenon B?
Build the dilemma from within: following the opponent's own premises to a terminus that either self-destructs or must import a premise contradicting its core
The siddhanta does two things only: point at the self-destruction, and state how one's own position absorbs everything the opponent explained—no added mockery
representative_cases_zh: 《梵经注》对唯识的 purvapaksha：把'唯识无境'立到能解释梦与幻觉，再以'记忆锚点''识之对象结构'从内部击穿——最强对手法的教科书示范
对弥曼差：先把'仪式自足、无须梵'立成完整体系（弥曼差确是当时主流），再以'有效性从何而来'追击——从承认对手主流地位开始
传说中的曼陀罗弥湿罗之辩：商羯罗先与对手之妻辩'家政法'以补齐自身知识的短板，再进入义理主战场——'知彼'纪律的极端示范
representative_cases_en: The purvapaksha of Yogacara in the Brahma-sutra commentary: 'consciousness-only' stated strong enough to explain dream and illusion, then pierced from within by the anchors of memory and the object-structure of cognition—the textbook demonstration

Against Mimamsa: 'ritual suffices, no Brahman needed' first stated as a complete system (Mimamsa being the then-dominant school), then pursued with 'whence the validity?'—beginning by granting the opponent's dominance

The legendary debate with Mandana Misra: Shankara first debated the opponent's wife on 'household conduct' to close the gaps in his own knowledge before entering the doctrinal main contest—the extreme discipline of 'knowing the other'
modern_applications_zh: 评审/辩论准备：写'对方最强辩护词'并请对方阵营的人审校后再设计反驳——驳稻草人不产生知识
竞争分析：把竞品战略重构为'若我是对方，这是我会做的最优解'，再找其结构性代价——低估对手的战略必然失败
学术综述写作：每一批评前先以对手的最佳形态复述其观点，'钢人'标准替代'稻草人'标准
modern_applications_en: Review and debate preparation: draft the opponent's strongest defense, have their camp audit it, then design the rebuttal—refuting a straw man produces no knowledge
Competitive analysis: reconstruct the rival's strategy as 'the optimal move were I them,' then locate its structural cost—strategy built on underestimating opponents fails
Academic review writing: restate each view in its best form before criticizing—the steel-man standard replacing the straw man

representative_figures.relation_zh: 本模式的原型——把 purvapaksha 从论辩礼节提升为'重构即信誉'的写作纪律
representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—who elevated purvapaksha from a courtesy of debate into the writing discipline 'reconstruction is credit'

representative_figures.relation_zh: 技术环境——佛教因明学为整个论辩传统提供了'立敌共许'的形式规范
representative_figures.relation_en: the technical milieu—Buddhist logic supplied the formal norms of 'shared premises' for the whole disputation tradition

representative_figures.relation_zh: 平行对照——'任何反驳若非对对手论证最强形态的反驳即无价值'，与 purvapaksha 纪律几乎逐字相同
representative_figures.relation_en: the parallel—'a refutation of the weakest form of an argument is worthless' matches the purvapaksha discipline almost verbatim

name_zh: 极限概念方法论/对不可定义者只作否定性定义（'不是这，不是那'，neti neti）——凡可指认、可言说、可对象化的都被系统否定，留下的沉默即是答案：以'排除法'逼近绝对，避免把绝对降格为诸概念中的一个概念
name_en: methodology for limit-concepts/the undefinable receives only negative definition ('not this, not that,' neti neti)—whatever can be pointed at, spoken, or objectified is systematically denied, and the silence left standing is the answer: approaching the absolute by elimination, keeping it from degradation into one concept among concepts
category: 极限概念方法论/对不可定义者只作否定性定义（'不是这，不是那'）——凡可指认、可言说、可对象化的都被系统否定，留下的沉默即是答案
modes.domain_zh: 《大森林奥义书》'不是这，不是那'被商羯罗提升为方法。《梵经注》对'梵是什么'的回答策略：不陈述梵的性质，而逐项否定一切可陈述者——梵不是粗大物、不是细微物、不是短、不是长、不生、不灭、无名无色——每一次否定都排除一个'可能被误认为梵'的概念（创世神、能量、空、时间、本体范畴），排除完毕，'剩下的那个不可排除者'即是方向。方法的要点：绝对若被肯定地定义，就成了可指认的对象——而对象必有边界，有边界者即有限，即非绝对；故唯一的诚实言说是'梵不是任何你可指认者'。这与'否定神学'（托名狄奥尼修斯、迈蒙尼德'否定的属性'、埃克哈特）构成跨文明的方法族：上帝只能以否定谓词言说。但商羯罗的版本更激进一步：否定不仅是修辞的，还是认识论的——'排除法'本身被设计成一条认识路径（连同亲证检验 M-SHA-006），即'每否定一层错觉，真就显一分'——遮诠是'显影'而非'空话'。代价与极限：纯粹否定使体系在积极教义上'可被任何填充'，后世争论多源于此；对不熟悉该传统的读者，遮诠极易被误读为虚无主义；且否定到极致后，'为何还要言说'的自反问题始终存在。
modes.domain_en: The Brihadaranyaka Upanishad's 'not this, not that' was raised by Shankara into a method. The commentary's strategy on 'what is Brahman': state no property of Brahman, but negate in succession everything statable—Brahman is not the gross, not the subtle, not short, not long, unborn, undying, nameless, formless—each negation excluding one concept that might be mistaken for Brahman (creator-god, energy, space, time, substance); when the exclusions are complete, 'what cannot be excluded' is the direction. The point: an affirmatively defined absolute becomes a pointable-at object—objects have boundaries, the bounded is finite, the finite is not absolute; so the only honest utterance is 'Brahman is not anything you can point at.' With negative theology (Pseudo-Dionysius, Maimonides' negative attributes, Eckhart) this forms a cross-civilizational method family: God can be spoken only by denied predicates. But Shankara's version goes one step further: negation is not merely rhetorical but epistemic—elimination is itself designed as a path of knowing (paired with experience-verification, M-SHA-006): each negation of an illusion lets the real emerge by one degree—apophasis as 'developing,' not idle talk. Costs and limits: pure negation leaves the system fillable by anything, the source of endless later dispute; for readers outside the tradition apophasis reads easily as nihilism; and the reflexive question 'why speak at all' never disappears.
modes.definition_zh: 极限概念方法论/对不可定义者只作否定性定义——凡可指认、可言说、可对象化的都被系统否定，留下的沉默即是答案：以排除法逼近绝对，避免把绝对降格为诸概念中的一个
modes.definition_en: Methodology for limit-concepts/the undefinable receives only negative definition—whatever can be pointed at or spoken is systematically denied, the silence left standing is the answer: approaching the absolute by elimination, keeping it from becoming one concept among concepts
modes.source_chapter: 《大森林奥义书》3.9.26 'neti neti' 及商羯罗注；《梵经注》1.1.14-20 论梵之不可描述性；《千部解脱论》论名言与真实之分界
key_concepts: 遮诠 neti neti（否定性定义）
排除法认识论 elimination as epistemology
不可对象化 the non-objectifiable
显影式否定 negation as developing
沉默的所指 what the silence indicates
modes.key_quote_zh: 不是这，不是那——凡被指出的都不是；未指出的，即是。
modes.key_quote_en: Not this, not that—whatever is pointed at is not it; what is never pointed at, that it is.
process_zh: 确认对象属于'极限概念'（不可定义、不可指认、一经定义即失真）——此类对象禁用肯定定义
开列'误认候选清单'：一切可能被当作答案的常见概念（在此传统：创世神、能量、空、时间……）
逐项否定并说明'为何它不是'：每项否定须给出理由，而非空喊——排除法是论证不是修辞
指向残余：排除完毕后以'那不可排除者'指路，并声明一切言说到此为止——沉默是方法的完成而非失败
process_en: Confirm the object is a limit-concept (undefinable, unpointable-at, falsified by any definition)—affirmative definition is banned for it
Draw up the list of candidates for misidentification: every common concept that might be mistaken for the answer (in this tradition: creator-god, energy, space, time...)
Negate item by item with reasons: each negation must argue why it is not—elimination is argument, not rhetoric
Point at the remainder: with exclusions complete, indicate 'what cannot be excluded' and declare all speech ended—the silence is the method's completion, not its failure
representative_cases_zh: 《梵经注》：对'梵'逐项否定（不粗不细不短不长……）——遮诠法的总纲示范，每一次否定排除一个误认候选
《大森林奥义书》'neti neti' 注：把'不是这，不是那'从神秘短语提升为认识路径——排除本身即'显影'
与否定神学的平行：迈蒙尼德规定'上帝只有否定属性'，与商羯罗'梵只可否定地言说'构成跨文明方法族——各自独立立法、同一逻辑
representative_cases_en: The Brahma-sutra commentary: Brahman denied item by item (not gross, not subtle, not short, not long...)—the master demonstration, each negation excluding one candidate for misidentification
The commentary on 'neti neti': a mystical phrase raised into a path of knowing—exclusion itself as 'developing' the real

The parallel with negative theology: Maimonides' 'God has only negative attributes' beside Shankara's 'Brahman is spoken only negatively'—an independent, cross-civilizational legislation of the same logic
modern_applications_zh: 核心概念提炼：对'我们的核心价值观是什么'先做排除法（列出一切'不是'），剩下的空间往往比正面口号更精确
复杂系统描述：对不可直接观测的变量（如'组织文化''市场情绪'），用'排除了所有可测解释后残余的方向'来指示——负空间法
产品差异化：不说'我们是什么'，逐项说'我们不是什么'——排除法定位在嘈杂市场中辨识度更高
modern_applications_en: Core-concept extraction: for 'what are our values,' run elimination first (list everything we are not)—the remaining space is often more precise than any positive slogan

Describing complex systems: for unobservable variables ('organizational culture,' 'market sentiment'), indicate by 'the direction remaining after all measurable explanations are excluded'—the negative-space method
Product differentiation: instead of saying what you are, say item by item what you are not—eliminative positioning cuts through noisy markets

representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—who legislated neti neti from a mystical phrase into the epistemic path 'exclusion as developing'

representative_figures.relation_en: the parallel legislator—the Western source of negative theology: God spoken only through denied predicates

representative_figures.relation_zh: 平行立法者——'否定的属性'：肯定谓词加于上帝即歪曲，与商羯罗逻辑逐点相同
representative_figures.relation_en: the parallel legislator—'negative attributes': affirmative predicates distort God, point-for-point the logic of Shankara

name_zh: 认识裁决方法论/经典与推理都只是'指向的手指'，最终裁决在直接体验（anubhava）——'梵我同一'必须被亲证而非被相信：读经生信、逻辑生解，皆只是准备；未经体验核验的结论，暂记为假设
name_en: epistemic-adjudication methodology/scripture and inference are both 'fingers pointing'; final judgment lies in direct experience (anubhava)—'Brahman is the Self' must be realized, not believed: faith from reading and understanding from logic are only preparation; conclusions unverified by experience are held as hypotheses
category: 认识裁决方法论/经典与推理都只是'指向的手指'，最终裁决在直接体验——'梵我同一'必须被亲证而非被相信；未经体验核验的结论暂记为假设
modes.domain_zh: 不二论常被误读为纯思辨体系，商羯罗本人的立场恰恰相反。《千部解脱论》明确划分三个认识阶段：闻（sravana，听经）、思（manana，以推理检验听闻所得、清除疑点）、修（nididhyasana，使之成为不间断的体验）——并申明次序不可跳级：推理不通就信，是迷信；推理通了不修，是空谈。他在《梵经注》中为'亲证'保留最终裁决权：当经典与推理冲突，或经典内部冲突，最后的检验标准是'梵我同一能否被亲证'——因为《奥义书》诸句的权威本身来源于最初亲证者的报告（'我看见了'），圣传句是'证人证词'，而证人证词永远可以被新一轮亲证刷新。这一立场使不二论在结构上接近'可重复实验'的认识形态：导师（guru）提供实验设计，经典提供前人数据，弟子必须自己重做实验。代价与极限：'亲证'不可公开复现、无仪器测量，批判者指其为'私人语言'的认识论风险；且体验的报告永远要借旧概念言说，'刷新'与'误读'的界线模糊——商羯罗以'与圣传句不冲突'作为体验合格的过滤器，而这又把权威还给了经典，循环未彻底解开。
modes.domain_en: Advaita is often misread as pure speculation; Shankara's own position is the reverse. The Upadesasahasri divides knowing into three stages: hearing (sravana), reflection (manana—testing what was heard by inference, clearing doubts), and meditation (nididhyasana—making it unbroken experience)—the order may not be skipped: believing without inferential clarity is superstition; clarity without practice is empty talk. In the Brahma-sutra commentary he reserves final adjudication for realization: when scripture and inference conflict, or scripture conflicts with itself, the last test is whether 'Brahman-Atman identity' can be realized—for the authority of the Upanishadic sayings itself derives from the reports of the first realizers ('I saw'); the great sayings are witness-testimony, and witness-testimony can always be refreshed by new realization. This gives non-dualism the structure of 'repeatable experiment' knowing: the teacher (guru) supplies the experimental design, scripture the data of predecessors, the disciple must redo the experiment personally. Costs and limits: realization is not publicly replicable or instrumentally measured; critics charge the epistemic risk of a 'private language'; and reports of experience must speak in old concepts, blurring the line between 'refreshing' and 'misreading'—Shankara filters qualified experience by non-contradiction with the great sayings, which hands authority back to scripture, a circle never fully closed.

modes.definition_en: Epistemic-adjudication methodology/scripture and inference are 'fingers pointing'; final judgment lies in direct experience—'Brahman is the Self' must be realized, not believed; conclusions unverified by experience are held as hypotheses
modes.source_chapter: 《千部解脱论》闻思修三阶；本集第一篇论导师与亲证；《梵经注》论'亲证为最终裁决'
key_concepts: 闻思修 sravana-manana-nididhyasana
指向的手指 fingers pointing
亲证 anubhava（直接体验裁决）
圣传句即证人证言 mahavakya as testimony
假设暂记 conclusions held as hypotheses
modes.key_quote_zh: 经典指出方向，推理清除疑云，唯有体验完成认识。
modes.key_quote_en: Scripture points the way, inference clears the doubts, experience alone completes the knowing.
process_zh: 为待检验命题安排三阶：先闻（吸收最权威的表述），再思（以推理正面与反面检验、清除全部疑点），后修（设体验程序使其成为直接认识）
把一切未亲证的结论标记为'假设'——包括自己最珍视的信念；假设不驱动最终行动
设计'可重复的体验程序'（冥想、自省、特定情境下的观察），使结论可以在自身经验中被再次检验
以'与既有可靠证词不冲突'过滤体验报告：新体验刷新旧证词的资格，以其与整体验证链的相容性为条件
process_en: Arrange three stages for the proposition under test: hearing (absorb the most authoritative statement), reflection (test it by inference both ways, clear all doubts), meditation (design a practice making it direct knowing)
Mark every unrealized conclusion as 'hypothesis'—including one's most cherished beliefs; hypotheses do not drive final action
Design repeatable experiential procedures (meditation, self-examination, observation in specified situations) so the conclusion can be re-tested within one's own experience

Filter experience-reports by non-contradiction with the reliable testimony already held: new experience earns the right to refresh old testimony only through coherence with the whole chain of verification
representative_cases_zh: 《千部解脱论》：闻-思-修三阶的完整立法——'推理不通就信是迷信，推理通了不修是空谈'的次序纪律
《梵经注》的认识论：圣传句被定性为'最初亲证者的证词'——权威来源于体验，故体验有权刷新权威
师徒传承制度：导师提供'实验设计'、弟子'重做实验'——亲证检验法被制度化为八百年不辍的传承系统
representative_cases_en: The Upadesasahasri: the full legislation of hearing-reflection-meditation—'believing without clarity is superstition; clarity without practice is empty talk'
The epistemology of the Brahma-sutra commentary: the great sayings defined as 'testimony of the first realizers'—authority sourced in experience, hence refreshable by experience
The guru-disciple institution: the teacher supplies the experimental design, the disciple redoes the experiment—experience-verification institutionalized as an eight-century lineage
modern_applications_zh: 个人学习系统：对任何重要主张执行'闻思修'——吸收最强表述、正反推理清疑、设计可重复的个人验证程序，未完成三阶前标记为假设
科学素养：把'权威文献=证人证词'——尊重但可刷新；自己的重复实验是认识的完成动作，不是可选项
管理决策：先高层听（吸收内外部最强观点）、再推理（红队检验）、再试点（组织层面的'亲证'），三阶不齐不全员推开
modern_applications_en: A personal learning system: run hearing-reflection-practice on any major claim—absorb the strongest statement, test by inference both ways, design a repeatable personal verification; before all three, mark it hypothesis
Scientific literacy: treat authoritative literature as witness-testimony—respected but refreshable; one's own replication is the completing act of knowing, not optional
Management decisions: first absorb the strongest internal and external views, then red-team the reasoning, then pilot (the organization's 'realization'); never roll out before all three stages

representative_figures.relation_zh: 本模式的原型——把'亲证'立法为认识链的最终裁决者，使哲学具有'可重复实验'的结构
representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—who legislated realization as final adjudicator, giving philosophy the structure of repeatable experiment

representative_figures.relation_zh: 先师——'醒梦眠'三相分析为亲证提供了可自检的现象学清单
representative_figures.relation_en: the precursor—whose three states (waking, dream, sleep) supplied a self-checkable phenomenological checklist for realization

representative_figures.relation_zh: 平行对照——'宗教经验之种类'以个人体验为第一手数据，与亲证裁决共享'体验是认识的原始数据'立场
representative_figures.relation_en: the parallel—The Varieties of Religious Experience treating personal experience as primary data, sharing the stance 'experience is the raw material of knowing'

name_zh: 修行/训练设计方法论/把'觉悟'这一不可跳级的目标拆成四道前置资格（分辨 vairagya 前的 viveka、离欲、六德、求解脱）与闻思修三阶——任何高阶转化都须先核查'备件齐不齐'，备件不齐者不接受高阶训练
name_en: methodology of training design/the unskippable goal 'awakening' is decomposed into four prior qualifications (discrimination, dispassion, the six virtues, the desire for liberation) and the three stages of hearing-reflection-meditation—any higher transformation first checks 'are the prerequisites complete'; the unqualified are not admitted to higher training
category: 修行/训练设计方法论/把'觉悟'拆成四道前置资格（分辨、离欲、六德、求解脱）与闻思修三阶——任何高阶转化先核查'备件齐不齐'，备件不齐者不接受高阶训练
modes.domain_zh: 《分辨宝鬘》开篇即是这套'招生标准'：求道者先自查四备——一、分辨（viveka，能分辨常与无常）；二、离欲（vairagya，对此世与彼世之果皆无贪着）；三、六德（shatsampat：制心、制感、退隐、忍耐、信、专注）；四、求解脱（mumukshutva，真渴求而非口头）。四备齐，方授'闻思修'三阶。这套设计的要害是把'顿悟'重新定义为'长期备件工程的最后一环'：商羯罗从不否认'一悟即至'的可能，但他指出悟的'即时性'建立在备件长期完备之上——如烧柴：最后一根火柴是即时的，但柴必须早已干燥。制度的用意还在于教育分层：四备不齐者先回到底层训练（持戒、服务、礼敬），不浪费高阶教导——这是对'老师该对谁讲什么'的资源分配方案。现代对照：运动训练的'力量基础先于专项技术'、数学教育的'先备知识检查'，都是同一阶梯逻辑。代价与极限：'备件核查'的裁量权在导师手里，易固化为门第门槛；且四备清单有文化特定性（如'离欲'对在家人的含义需重释），移植时须重新立法。
modes.domain_en: The opening of the Vivekacudamani is this admissions standard: the seeker first self-audits four qualifications—discrimination (viveka, between the permanent and the impermanent), dispassion (vairagya, no craving for the fruits of this world or the next), the six virtues (shatsampat: restraint of mind and senses, withdrawal, endurance, faith, concentration), and the longing for liberation (mumukshutva, true thirst, not verbal). With the four complete, the three stages of hearing-reflection-meditation are conferred. The crux: 'sudden awakening' is redefined as the last link of a long prerequisite-engineering—Shankara never denies awakening can be instant, but insists its instantaneity rests on long-completed readiness: like burning wood, the final match is instant, but the wood must long since be dry. The design also stratifies teaching: the unqualified return to foundational training (discipline, service, reverence), sparing the higher instruction—resource allocation for 'to whom should the teacher say what.' Modern parallels: 'strength base before sport-specific technique,' 'prerequisite checks in mathematics education'—the same ladder logic. Costs and limits: discretion over qualification sits with the teacher, easily hardening into pedigree gatekeeping; and the list is culturally specific ('dispassion' needs reinterpretation for householders), requiring re-legislation on transplant.
modes.definition_zh: 修行/训练设计方法论/把'觉悟'拆成四道前置资格与三阶训练——任何高阶转化先核查'备件齐不齐'，备件不齐者不接受高阶训练；'顿悟'的即时性建立在备件的长期完备之上
modes.definition_en: Methodology of training design/'awakening' decomposed into four prior qualifications and three stages—any higher transformation first checks prerequisite completeness; the unqualified are not admitted to higher training; the instantaneity of 'sudden awakening' rests on long-completed readiness
modes.source_chapter: 《分辨宝鬘》18-30 颂（四备清单）；《千部解脱论》闻思修三阶；四大道场的师徒授受制度
key_concepts: 四备 sadhana-catushtaya（分辨/离欲/六德/求解脱）
备件工程 prerequisite engineering
顿悟的柴火论 the dry-wood theory of sudden insight
教育分层 educational stratification
不可跳级 no skipping stages
modes.key_quote_zh: 最后一根火柴是即时的，但柴必须早已干燥。
modes.key_quote_en: The final match is instant, but the wood must long since be dry.
process_zh: 把目标拆解为'不可跳级的高阶转化'，明确它的真正前置条件（不是名义门槛，而是缺了必失败的备件）
为每道备件设计可自查的判据：分辨（能否说清常与无常）、离欲（对结果是否仍有贪着）……逐项核验而非总体印象
建立分层授受：备件齐者进入高阶，不齐者回底层训练并指定补件任务——高阶教导不发给未备者
把'突破'重新归因：任何'顿悟'发生时，先盘点是哪些长期备件使它可能——把奇迹改写为工程
process_en: Decompose the goal into an unskippable higher transformation and identify its true prerequisites—not nominal gates but components without which failure is certain

Design self-auditable criteria per qualification: discrimination (can one state the permanent vs impermanent), dispassion (does craving for outcomes remain)—verify item by item, not by overall impression
Institute stratified transmission: the qualified enter higher training; the unqualified return to foundational work with assigned remediation—higher instruction is not issued to the unprepared
Reattribute breakthroughs: whenever a 'sudden awakening' occurs, first inventory which long-built components made it possible—rewriting miracle as engineering
representative_cases_zh: 《分辨宝鬘》：四备清单作为'招生标准'逐项可查——求道者先自查再申请，导师先核验再授法
闻思修的次序纪律：思未通过不授修，修未成不称悟——三级之间同样执行备件核查
柴火论对'顿悟'的重释：传说中商羯罗本人早年即悟，但其师承仍要求完整训练——'即时性以完备性为前提'的立法样本
representative_cases_en: The Vivekacudamani: the fourfold list as an auditable admissions standard—the seeker self-audits before applying, the teacher verifies before instructing
The order-discipline of hearing-reflection-meditation: no meditation instruction before reflection passes, no claim of awakening before meditation matures—prerequisite checks between every stage
The dry-wood rereading of 'sudden awakening': the tradition holds Shankara realized early, yet his lineage still required full training—'instantaneity premised on completeness' legislated
modern_applications_zh: 人才培养：把关键岗位能力拆成可核查的备件清单（基础技能/判断力/心理稳定性），备件不齐不授高阶职责——晋升标准从'年限'改为'备件'
运动员训练：力量与技术分层——专项技术（高阶转化）只发给基础力量达标者，避免'用技术代偿力量'的伤病
变革管理：组织'顿悟式转型'前先盘点四备（认知分辨力/对现状的离欲/协作纪律/求变渴求），备件不齐先补件再转型
modern_applications_en: Talent development: decompose critical-role capability into auditable components (foundational skill, judgment, psychological stability); no higher responsibility until the components clear—promotion by 'prerequisites,' not tenure

Athletic training: strength and technique layered—sport-specific skill (the higher transformation) issued only to those whose strength base clears the bar, preventing injury from 'technique compensating for strength'

Change management: before an organization's 'epiphany transformation,' audit the fourfold readiness (cognitive discrimination, dispassion about the status quo, collaborative discipline, thirst for change); remediate first, transform second

representative_figures.relation_zh: 本模式的原型——把'觉悟'从奇迹改写为'备件工程+最后一环'
representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—who rewrote awakening from miracle into 'prerequisite engineering plus the final link'

representative_figures.relation_zh: 制度对手方——作为导师对少年商羯罗执行了完整的备件核验与授受，是阶梯的'执行侧'示范
representative_figures.relation_en: the institutional counterparty—as teacher he ran the full qualification audit and transmission on the young Shankara, the 'execution side' of the ladder

representative_figures.relation_zh: 平行立法者——'格物致知、循序渐进'的为学次第与四备阶梯同为'不可跳级'的东亚立法
representative_figures.relation_en: the parallel legislator—the sequence of 'investigating things, extending knowledge, advancing step by step' as the East Asian legislation of the same unskippable ladder

name_zh: 知识创业方法论/借注疏既有权威文本的外衣行新学派立法之实——为'三经'作注，使新学说获得旧文本的合法性背书，同时通过注解的选择性强调重塑文本本身——经典被'继承'的时刻正是被'改写'的时刻
name_en: knowledge-venture methodology/legislating a new school under the dress of commentary on authoritative texts—commenting on the 'three foundations' loans the new doctrine the legitimacy of the old, while selective emphasis in the gloss reshapes the text itself—the moment a classic is 'inherited' is the moment it is 'rewritten'
category: 知识创业方法论/借注疏既有权威文本的外衣行新学派立法之实——为'三经'作注使新学说获得合法性背书，同时通过注解的选择性强调重塑文本本身
modes.domain_zh: 商羯罗面对的战略处境：奥义书已是最高权威，但诸奥义书文本散漫、彼此侧重不同，且主流经院立场（弥曼差）主张'仪式至上、梵只是仪式的附属'。他的解法不是另立新经——新经没有权威——而是为权威作注：选定《梵经》、十部主要《奥义书》、《薄伽梵歌》（合称'三基' prasthana-traya），以注疏建立'不二'总纲。注疏的合法性在于'我只是解释'，而立法性在于解释权的行使：哪些段落被读作字面义、哪些被读作指示义（lakshana）、哪些奥义书入选'主要'名单、哪些诗句被解释为'仅为训导初学者'——每一次选择都在重塑传统。结果：《奥义书》从仪式手册的附录变成哲学经典的正典，吠檀多取代弥曼差成为义学中心，而他本人以'注家'身份成为事实上新传统的创始人。这套'托古改制'的工艺在人类知识史上反复出现：孔子'述而不作'、历代《论语》注、列宁对马克思的'注解'、海德格尔对康德的书——注疏是'变革者最安全的战场'。代价与极限：注疏合法性是一柄双刃剑——罗摩奴阇同样以注疏反击，把商羯罗的选择性强调逐条'再注解'回去；且托古使新立场永远背着'我只是在解释'的诚实性拷问。
modes.domain_en: Shankara's strategic situation: the Upanishads were the supreme authority, but the texts were diffuse, mutually divergent in emphasis, and the dominant scholastic position (Mimamsa) held 'ritual supreme, Brahman an appendage of ritual.' His solution was not to write a new scripture—new scripture carries no authority—but to comment on the authority: selecting the Brahma-sutras, the ten principal Upanishads and the Bhagavad Gita (together the prasthanatraya, 'three foundations'), and building the program of non-dualism through gloss. The legitimacy lies in 'I only interpret'; the legislation lies in exercising the right of interpretation—which passages read literally, which by indicated meaning (lakshana), which Upanishads enter the list of the 'principal,' which verses are glossed as 'instructing beginners only'—every choice reshaping the tradition. The result: the Upanishads turned from appendices of ritual manuals into the canon of philosophical classics, Vedanta displaced Mimamsa at the doctrinal center, and the commentator became the de facto founder of the new tradition. This craft of 'reform under the ancients' recurs across intellectual history: Confucius 'transmitting, not creating,' the commentarial dynasties on the Analects, Lenin's 'gloss' on Marx, Heidegger's book on Kant—commentary is the reformer's safest battlefield. Costs and limits: commentarial legitimacy is double-edged—Ramanuja struck back in commentary too, glossing Shankara's selective emphases away line by line; and the cloak of the ancients keeps the new position forever under the interrogation of honesty ('I am only explaining').
modes.definition_zh: 知识创业方法论/借注疏权威文本的外衣行新学派立法之实——注解的选择性强调（字面义/指示义、入选/落选、字面/训导）重塑传统本身——经典被'继承'的时刻正是被'改写'的时刻
modes.definition_en: Knowledge-venture methodology/legislating a new school under the dress of commentary—the selective emphasis of the gloss (literal vs indicated meaning, inclusion vs exclusion, doctrine vs pedagogy) reshapes the tradition itself—the moment a classic is 'inherited' is the moment it is 'rewritten'
modes.source_chapter: '三基'（prasthana-traya）的选定与注疏体例；《奥义书》'主要名单'的建构；《薄伽梵歌注》对'训导性段落'的处理
key_concepts: 三基 prasthanatraya（立法的文本基础）
注疏即立法 commentary as legislation
选择性强调 selective emphasis
指示义 lakshana（解释权的行使点）
托古改制 reform under the ancients
modes.key_quote_zh: 我不立新经——我为旧经作注；而传统在我注后已换了一副骨骼。
modes.key_quote_en: I write no new scripture—I comment on the old; yet the tradition after my gloss has a different skeleton.
process_zh: 盘点领域内的'权威文本'：确认哪些文本有无需自证的合法性，以及主流解释目前归于哪个阵营
选定'注疏根据地'（对应三基）：数目克制、层级分明（经/疏/论），并为每一部设计它在新体系中承担的功能
以注解行使解释权：区分字面义与指示义、正典与训导、核心与边缘——每一次区分都朝新总纲倾斜
让'继承'产生'改写'：注成之后，旧文本的引用权重、教学顺序、学派光谱都已被重新排列——新学派以注家身份出生
process_en: Inventory the field's authoritative texts: which carry legitimacy requiring no proof, and which camp the mainstream interpretation currently serves
Select the commentarial base camps (the analog of the three foundations): few in number, clearly ranked (root text/gloss/treatise), each assigned its function in the new system
Exercise interpretive right through the gloss: separate literal from indicated meaning, canon from pedagogy, core from margin—each separation tilting toward the new program
Let inheritance produce rewriting: once the gloss is done, citation weights, teaching order and the spectrum of schools are rearranged—the new school born wearing the commentator's gown
representative_cases_zh: 三基的选定与注疏：《梵经》《薄伽梵歌》、十部主要《奥义书》——'主要名单'本身就是立法（落选的奥义书从此边缘化）
对'仪式段落'的处理：将吠陀仪式性经文解释为'为初级者设的训导'——以注解把弥曼差的核心降格为'入门教材'，完成义学中心的转移
历史上反复出现的同型工程：孔子'述而不作'以删述六经立儒学；海德格尔以康德书重建现象学——注疏是变革者最安全的战场
representative_cases_en: Selecting and glossing the three foundations: the Brahma-sutras, the Gita, the ten 'principal' Upanishads—the very list of the principal is legislation (the excluded Upanishads marginalized ever after)
Handling the ritual passages: Vedic ritual texts glossed as 'instruction for beginners'—the Mimamsa core demoted to introductory material by commentary alone, the doctrinal center displaced

The recurring type across history: Confucius 'transmitting, not creating' founding Confucianism through editing the classics; Heidegger rebuilding phenomenology through a book on Kant—commentary as the reformer's safest battlefield
modern_applications_zh: 行业标准策略：新公司不为空白领域另立标准，而是'深度参与'现有权威标准的修订——以'解释与补充'实现事实立法
组织变革：改革者以'重新解读创始人文本/公司宪法'推行新战略——托古改制比另起炉灶的阻力低一个量级
学术切入点选择：博士论文选主流经典的'再解释'而非无人问津的新题目——权威文本的注疏自带读者与合法性
modern_applications_en: Standards strategy: rather than founding a standard in a blank field, a newcomer 'participates deeply' in revising the authoritative existing one—de facto legislation through 'interpretation and supplement'

Organizational change: reformers push new strategy by reinterpreting the founder's texts or the company constitution—reform under the ancients meets an order of magnitude less resistance than building anew
Choosing an academic entry point: a dissertation reinterpreting a canonical text rather than a neglected novelty—commentary on an authority brings readers and legitimacy with it

representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—founder of a new tradition wearing the commentator's gown, the highest completion of commentary-as-legislation

representative_figures.relation_zh: 同型立法者——'述而不作'：以删述六经完成儒学立法，与商羯罗共享托古战略
representative_figures.relation_en: the same-type legislator—'transmitting, not creating': Confucianism legislated through editing the classics, sharing Shankara's strategy of reform under the ancients

representative_figures.relation_en: the method's adversary—commentary answered with commentary, re-glossing Shankara's emphases line by line—the craft's self-counterattack

name_zh: 意识哲学方法论/把意识定位为自明自证的'见证'（sakshi）——一切认识需要认识者，而认识者本身不需要被认识（灯不自需照）；凡被观察者皆非观察者，沿此'见证线'可从任何经验回溯到不可被经验的不落之点
name_en: philosophy-of-consciousness methodology/consciousness is located as the self-luminous 'witness' (sakshi)—every cognition requires a cognizer, and the cognizer itself needs no cognizing (the lamp needs no lighting); whatever is observed is not the observer, and along this 'witness line' any experience can be traced back to the unfailing point that cannot itself be experienced
category: 意识哲学方法论/把意识定位为自明自证的'见证'——一切认识需要认识者，而认识者本身不需要被认识（灯不自需照）；凡被观察者皆非观察者
modes.domain_zh: 这是商羯罗意识哲学的枢纽操作，也是不二还原法（M-SHA-001）的发动机。论证三步。第一，'观察者-被观察者'分离律：任何我能描述、感受、观察的东西（情绪、念头、身体感、甚至'我在冥想'这一念头）都处在'被看见'一侧——而'看见'本身从未出现在被看见的清单里；于是意识不是诸经验之一，而是经验得以呈现的'位置'。第二，自明性论证：认识者若需另一认识者来认识，将无穷倒退——故必有一层认识是自明的（svaprakasha，自照），如灯照明他物而不需另一盏灯来照亮自己。第三，'见证'的恒在性：醒、梦、深眠三相流转，而'我觉知到'贯穿三相——深眠中'我睡得很沉'的报告预设了那个一直醒着的见证。这套操作在二十世纪获得了惊人的平行物：现象学的'反思剩余'（胡塞尔：一切被对象化的都不是先验自我）、'注意 LED 灯'悖论（你无法看见'正在看'本身）。方法的现代用途：任何'我在观察 X'的陈述都可追向'谁在观察'——一层层回撤到不可回撤处，那是主体性的锚点。代价与极限：'见证'恒在性从记忆报告推出（深眠论证），而报告属于醒时——推理跨度可争议；且把一切归于'见证'有化约风险：决策、情绪、身体各有其层，不应全部注销为'见证的投影'。
modes.domain_en: The pivot of Shankara's philosophy of consciousness and the engine of non-dual reduction (M-SHA-001). Three steps. First, the observer-observed split: anything I can describe, feel, or observe—an emotion, a thought, a bodily sensation, even the thought 'I am meditating'—stands on the 'seen' side, while the 'seeing' itself never appears on the list of the seen; consciousness is therefore not one experience among others but the 'place' where experience appears. Second, the self-luminosity argument: if the cognizer needed another cognizer to cognize it, the regress would be infinite—so one stratum of knowing must be self-luminous (svaprakasha, self-illuminating), as a lamp lights other things without needing another lamp to light itself. Third, the witness's permanence: waking, dream and deep sleep rotate, while 'I am aware' runs through all three—the deep-sleep report 'I slept soundly' presupposes the witness that never slept. The operation won astonishing twentieth-century parallels: phenomenology's 'reflective remainder' (Husserl: whatever is objectified is not the transcendental ego), the 'attention headlight' paradox (you cannot see the seeing itself). Modern use: any statement 'I observe X' can be pursued with 'who observes?'—withdrawing layer by layer to the irrevocable, the anchor of subjectivity. Costs and limits: the witness's permanence is inferred from memory-reports (the deep-sleep argument), and reports belong to waking—a contestable inferential span; and totalizing 'witness' risks reduction—decision, emotion, body each have their stratum and should not all be cancelled into 'projections of the witness.'
modes.definition_zh: 意识哲学方法论/把意识定位为自明自证的'见证'——一切认识需要认识者，而认识者本身不需要被认识（灯不自需照）；凡被观察者皆非观察者，沿'见证线'从任何经验回溯到不可被经验的不落之点
modes.definition_en: Philosophy-of-consciousness methodology/consciousness as the self-luminous 'witness'—every cognition requires a cognizer, and the cognizer itself needs no cognizing (the lamp needs no lighting); whatever is observed is not the observer; along the witness line any experience traces back to the unfailing point that cannot be experienced

自明 svaprakasha（灯不自需照）
观察者-被观察者分离 the observer-observed split

modes.key_quote_zh: 灯照明万物而不需另一盏灯照亮自己；觉知亦然。
modes.key_quote_en: The lamp lights all things without another lamp to light it; so too awareness.
process_zh: 对当前任一经验内容（念头、情绪、感受）执行'分离律'：把它放入'被观察'一侧，追问'谁在观察'——它不是观察者
沿'见证线'回撤：新出现的'观察者'（如'我在觉察'的念头）同样落入被观察侧——继续回撤，直到一个不再出现在清单上的项
以'灯喻'检验自明性：该最终项是否还需被认识？若需，则继续倒退；不需，则它是自明者——认识链的截止点
做三相检验（醒/梦/深眠）：检查'觉知'是否在三种状态报告中都预设地出现——贯通者即见证，见证即'我'的深层
process_en: Run the split on any current content (thought, emotion, sensation): place it on the 'observed' side and ask 'who observes'—it is not the observer
Withdraw along the witness line: the newly surfaced 'observer' (say, the thought 'I am aware') likewise falls on the observed side—continue until a term no longer appears on the list
Test self-luminosity with the lamp image: does this final term itself need to be known? If yes, the regress continues; if no, it is the self-luminous—where the chain of knowing stops
Run the three-state test (waking/dream/deep sleep): check whether 'awareness' is presupposed in all three state-reports—what runs through them is the witness, and the witness is the deep 'I'
representative_cases_zh: 《梵经注》'见证'章：把意识从诸经验中'提走'——凡被知觉者皆非知觉本身——见证定位法的总纲
深眠论证：'我睡得很香'的报告预设深眠中仍有'觉知到无'者——以日常经验为三相贯通提供样品
二十世纪的平行物：胡塞尔'一切被对象化的都不是先验自我'——现象学反思剩余与 sakshi 定位的同构
representative_cases_en: The 'witness' chapters of the Brahma-sutra commentary: consciousness lifted out from among experiences—whatever is perceived is not perception itself—the master statement of witness-location
The deep-sleep argument: the report 'I slept soundly' presupposes one who 'knew the nothing' through sleep—daily experience supplying the specimen of witness through three states
The twentieth-century parallel: Husserl's 'whatever is objectified is not the transcendental ego'—the phenomenological remainder isomorphic with the sakshi location
modern_applications_zh: 元认知训练：对'我在焦虑'执行分离律——'焦虑'是被观察的内容，'觉知到焦虑'者是另一项；回撤训练降低内容与主体的融合
产品设计中的'观察者盲区'：用户测试记录'用户做了什么'时，同步追问'记录者的视角预设是什么'——凡被记录者皆非记录框架
AI 与意识讨论：'系统输出可被观察'不等于'系统的观察者可被观察'——分离律为意识归因提供纪律
modern_applications_en: Metacognitive training: run the split on 'I am anxious'—anxiety is observed content; the one aware of anxiety is another term; withdrawal training reduces fusion of content with subject
The observer's blind spot in product research: alongside recording 'what the user did,' ask 'what the recorder's perspective presupposes'—whatever is recorded is not the recording frame
AI and consciousness debates: 'the system's output is observable' does not entail 'the system's observer is observable'—the split disciplines attribution of consciousness

name_zh: 组织传承方法论/一生的体系必须转化为不依赖本人存续的制度：立'根本道场'四座分镇四方、立'十名'僧团定传承谱系、立'修行阶梯'使体系可教学——创始人以三十二岁早逝收束，而体系以制度续命八百年：人死去，生成机制活着
name_en: methodology of institutional succession/a lifetime's system must be converted into institutions that survive the founder: four paramount monasteries anchoring the four quarters, the Dashanami order fixing the lineage, a graded curriculum making the system teachable—the founder closing his life at thirty-two while the system lives on institutionally for eight centuries: the man dies, the generative mechanism lives
category: 组织传承方法论/一生的体系必须转化为不依赖本人存续的制度：立四根本道场分镇四方、立'十名'僧团定传承谱系、立修行阶梯使体系可教学——创始人早逝而体系以制度续命八百年：人死去，生成机制活着
modes.domain_zh: 商羯罗三十二年的一生里，最后一步战略不是写更多书，而是'把自己替换掉'。其一，地理冗余：四大根本道场（南方斯林格里、西方德瓦拉卡、东方普里、北方乔提尔/巴德林纳特）分镇次大陆四角，任何一地被毁，教法不绝——单点失败被地理设计预先排除。其二，谱系冗余：'十名'（Dashanami）游方僧团以十个法名分支定组织谱系，导师-弟子授受制度使'亲证检验'（M-SHA-006）可以代代重做——体系不依赖任何个体的不可复制性。其三，教学法冗余：四备阶梯（M-SHA-007）与三阶训练把'悟'拆成可教、可查、可复现的程序——高阶知识降维成课程表，任何人可循阶而上。这三层设计合成的效果：创始人死后体系不衰减反而扩张，至今四位商羯罗阿阇梨仍是印度教最高教阶之一。对比样本：许多天才体系（兰波的诗歌革命、图灵的部分设想）随人亡而中断，正因缺少'生成机制'的转移。代价与极限：制度化必然带来教义僵化风险——后世道场之间的正统之争、对商羯罗本人观点的'道场化'改写，都是制度续命的暗面；且'四个道场'的历史证据晚出，制度叙事与史实之间有千年层累——这本身提醒：传承叙事也是被传承者不断'注疏'的对象。
modes.domain_en: In a life of thirty-two years, Shankara's final strategic move was not to write more books but to 'replace himself.' First, geographic redundancy: the four paramount monasteries (Sringeri in the south, Dwarka in the west, Puri in the east, Joshi/Badrinath in the north) anchoring the four quarters of the subcontinent—destroy one and the teaching survives; single points of failure excluded by design. Second, genealogical redundancy: the Dashanami order of renouncers, ten name-branches fixing the organizational lineage, with teacher-disciple transmission making 'experience-verification' (M-SHA-006) redoable generation after generation—the system depending on no individual's irreplaceability. Third, pedagogical redundancy: the fourfold ladder (M-SHA-007) and the three stages decompose 'awakening' into teachable, auditable, repeatable procedure—higher knowledge dimensioned down into a curriculum anyone may climb. The composite effect: after the founder's death the system expanded rather than decayed, and the four Shankaracharyas remain among the highest dignities of Hinduism. The contrast: genius-systems lacking transfer of their 'generative mechanism' (Rimbaud's poetic revolution, parts of Turing's vision) broke off with the man. Costs and limits: institutionalization carries doctrinal sclerosis—later orthodox disputes among the monasteries, 'monastic' rewriting of Shankara's own views, the shadow side of institutional survival; and the historical evidence for the four monasteries is late, with centuries of strata between institutional narrative and fact—a reminder that succession narratives are themselves continually 'glossed' by the successors.
modes.definition_zh: 组织传承方法论/一生的体系必须转化为不依赖本人存续的制度：地理冗余（四方道场）、谱系冗余（僧团传承）、教学法冗余（可教学阶梯）——人死去，生成机制活着
modes.definition_en: Methodology of institutional succession/a lifetime's system must be converted into institutions surviving the founder: geographic redundancy (monasteries in four quarters), genealogical redundancy (the order's lineages), pedagogical redundancy (a teachable ladder)—the man dies, the generative mechanism lives
modes.source_chapter: 四大根本道场（amnaya-matha）的建立传统；'十名'（Dashanami）僧团制度；《分辨宝鬘》与《千部解脱论》的可教学化设计
key_concepts: 地理冗余 geographic redundancy（四方分镇）
谱系冗余 genealogical redundancy（十名僧团）
教学法冗余 pedagogical redundancy（阶梯课程）
生成机制转移 transfer of the generative mechanism
创始人可替换 founder replaceability
modes.key_quote_zh: 让体系不再需要我——这是我最后也是最重要的著作。
modes.key_quote_en: To make the system no longer need me—that was my last and greatest work.
process_zh: 把体系的'生命线'列成清单：哪些环节当前只系于创始人一人（知识、判断、网络、权威）
为每个单点设计冗余：地理冗余（多点分镇）、谱系冗余（多支传承、明定授受规则）、教学法冗余（把隐性知识拆成可教阶梯）
执行'替换自己'：亲自授权各支继承人、亲自编写/审定可教学的教材与准入标准——传承设计必须由创始人完成，不可代劳
以退出检验制度：创始人离场（或早逝）后审计体系是否仍自行生成新导师、新学生、新解答——衰减即补冗余
process_en: Inventory the system's lifelines: which links currently rest on the founder alone (knowledge, judgment, network, authority)

Design redundancy per single point: geographic (anchored at multiple sites), genealogical (multiple lineages with explicit transmission rules), pedagogical (tacit knowledge decomposed into a teachable ladder)

Execute self-replacement: personally authorize successors in each lineage, personally write or ratify the teachable materials and admission standards—succession design must be the founder's own work, not delegated
Test the institutions by exit: audit after the founder leaves (or dies early) whether the system still generates new teachers, students and answers on its own—decay signals missing redundancy
representative_cases_zh: 四大根本道场：分镇次大陆四角——任何一地被毁教法不绝，单点失败被地理设计预先排除
'十名'僧团与师徒授受：亲证检验法被做成可代代重做的'实验传统'——体系不依赖任何个体的不可复制性
早逝的最终检验：商羯罗约三十二岁去世，而体系在其死后八百年仍扩张——'人死去，生成机制活着'的完整样本
representative_cases_en: The four paramount monasteries anchoring the four quarters—any one destroyed, the teaching survives; single points of failure excluded by geographic design
The Dashanami order and guru-disciple transmission: experience-verification turned into an experiment-tradition redoable every generation—the system depending on no individual's irreplaceability
The final test of early death: Shankara died at about thirty-two, and eight centuries on the system had expanded—'the man dies, the generative mechanism lives' in full
modern_applications_zh: 创始人型企业传承：退休前完成三冗余——多点分设（地理）、多支接班与明定授权规则（谱系）、把创始人隐性判断写成可教课程（教学法），以'离场后仍能自我生成'为验收标准
开源项目可持续性：总线因子（bus factor）治理——文档、测试、多人维护权分镇，'任何一人离开项目不死'
知识产品（方法论/学派）设计：出书之外必须建'可教学的阶梯+可认证的传承谱系'，否则体系随个人热度衰减
modern_applications_en: Founder-led succession: complete the three redundancies before retiring—multi-site presence (geographic), multiple successors with explicit authorization rules (genealogical), the founder's tacit judgment written into teachable curricula (pedagogical); acceptance criterion: self-generation after departure
Open-source sustainability: bus-factor governance—documentation, tests and maintainer rights anchored at multiple points; 'any one person leaving, the project does not die'
Designing knowledge products (methodologies, schools): beyond the book, build 'a teachable ladder plus a certifiable lineage'—else the system decays with personal fame
